status.description: Final task status. Use completed only when the requested source change was implemented and the strongest available verification was attempted.

final_answer.description: Concise summary of the implemented change and verification result.

retrieved_context_files.description: Top-level array of repository-relative files that materially informed the solution. Use [] when no files were relied on. Do not place this list inside notes.

retrieved_context_spans.description: Top-level array of relied-on source spans. Use [] when no spans are useful to report. Do not place this list inside notes.

retrieved_context_symbols.description: Top-level array of important symbols relied on. Use [] when symbols are unknown or not useful. Do not place this list inside notes.

notes.description: Plain-text caveats, verification limitations, or blockers. Do not include JSON, XML, tags, or any required schema field in this string.
